### New

- Set print DPI under **Canvas → Print Resolution**. See how large the image will print in inches or centimetres while keeping its pixel dimensions unchanged. Related to discussion 249.

### Improvements

- Opening a file on Windows brings back the existing PaintFE window if it’s minimised. Related to issue 248.
- More Photoshop PSDs open with their layers intact. If PaintFE opens the flattened preview instead, it explains why. Related to issue 246.
- **Refine edges** remembers your last applied choice between background-removal runs. Related to issue 247.
- Local MCP tools on Windows no longer write a request and reply file for every call. That reduces disk activity during long drawing scripts. Related to issue 245.
